channel.title: Women's Six Nations
channel.desc: The Women's Six Nations is back and after the success of the Rugby World Cup, it could be the biggest one yet. Sarra Elgan catches up with some of the biggest stars of the tournament and finds out about their hopes ahead of the competition and their challenges away from the pitch. England's winning run is now up to 34 in the Women's Six Nations, and after winning the Women's Rugby World Cup, will anyone be able to get close to them this time around?
